description: A wicker basket of assorted fruit sits on a red bedspread next to a light green plate holding a long baguette and a single thin yellow stick. The right hand moves in from the right, pinches the yellow stick off the plate, lifts it up and over the basket, lowers it into the basket among the fruit, then withdraws back toward the plate, leaving the yellow piece behind in the basket as the right-hand object is released.
